scope: Event-mode overdue capacity retry and static terminal-contract hardening; no native capture or efficacy claim

static_advance.finding: The terminal evaluator did not previously require config identity, top-level checkpoint identity, native-input identity, or hierarchical partition validity during capture validation.
implementation: Require config_path, config_sha256, and top-level checkpoint_sha256 in captures.
Bind each row checkpoint_sha256 to the capture manifest.
Require valid native_input_sha256 on every row and equality across paired rows.
Revalidate hierarchical partition fields and require equality of hierarchical_partition_sha256 across paired rows.
Accept canonical integer or JSON-round-tripped decimal-string child-map keys without changing the canonical hash.

blocker.blocker: Authorized server-6 GPU7 capacity remains occupied by M197-PIRS plus one foreign process.
blocker.unblock_condition: M197-PIRS reaches terminal state or GPU7 has fewer than two processes with sufficient measured free memory.
blocker.alternatives_attempted: Rechecked live GPU capacity and M197 native progress, then advanced the frozen paired-capture contract with additional fail-closed identity and hierarchy validation.

limitations: The capture identities are validated structurally; they are not authenticated against an external signed manifest.
No paired native capture ran, so no P1/P2/P3 or efficacy result is claimed.
M197-PIRS remains prior-art engineering evidence and does not authorize a successor mechanism.
